instruction: Export the current webpage as a PDF file named 'LLM Powered Autonomous Agents _ Lil'Log.pdf' and store it on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires saving the webpage as PDF to Desktop. Evaluator checks that the PDF file exists, has valid PDF structure (magic bytes), and has minimum size of 50KB to ensure content was saved. Similar to original but focuses on file existence and basic content validation rather than comparing against gold PDF.
